title: AgentPay SDK — Pattern Extraction for OMEL
decision: ADOPT_PATTERN — Copy architecture patterns for ClawRouter key management. DO NOT integrate SDK directly. DO NOT use USD1.
rationale: AgentPay ships production implementations of 2/5 OMEL mechanisms (Credential Vault + Human Brake). Architecture is sound and MIT-licensed. Political risk (WLFI/Trump association) makes direct SDK integration inadvisable for Deeploy enterprise/pharma. Pattern extraction is the safe path.

criteria.name: Token agnosticism
criteria.question: Does the policy engine support any ERC-20, or is it USD1-hardcoded?
criteria.assessment: LIKELY_PASS — Backlog doc describes policy engine accepting 'arbitrary token contract address'. USDC contract works on Ethereum. Needs source code verification when repo cloned.
criteria.kognai_action: Implement policy engine with USDC on Base (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) as default token. Token address configurable.

criteria.name: Chain flexibility
criteria.question: Does the SDK support Base (chainId 8453)?
criteria.assessment: LIKELY_PASS — Config file accepts chainId. Base (8453) should work if RPC endpoint provided.
criteria.kognai_action: ClawRouter key management layer targets Base (8453) exclusively. No BSC support needed.

criteria.name: vault-daemon isolation
criteria.question: Does Unix socket pattern prevent key exposure to agent processes?
criteria.assessment: PASS — Architecture confirmed: agent sends {to, amount, token, network}, vault returns {signed_tx_hex}. Key never in agent memory or logs.
criteria.kognai_action: Replicate Unix domain socket pattern in ClawRouter. Agent processes get mock .env. Real keys only in vault process.

criteria.name: Policy engine extensibility
criteria.question: Can spend limits be customised for ACP-based rules?
criteria.assessment: LIKELY_PASS — Three-outcome model (auto-execute, pause, reject) with configurable thresholds. Custom rule functions described.
criteria.kognai_action: Map ACP score tiers to spend thresholds: ACP>80 = higher daily cap, ACP<50 = lower cap + mandatory approval.

criteria.name: EIP-3009 timeline
criteria.question: Is gasless meta-transaction support on roadmap?
criteria.assessment: IN_PROGRESS — EIP-3009 mentioned as roadmap item. Not yet shipped.
criteria.kognai_action: Watch EIP-3009 for Invoica agent wallets (eliminates gas management). Not blocking for Kognai Phase 2A.

political_risk_assessment.invoica_x402: MEDIUM — current stack is USDC on Base, no reason to change
political_risk_assessment.deeploy_pharma: HIGH — EU MDR/FDA compliance clients cannot use Trump-affiliated infra
political_risk_assessment.deeploy_gov: HIGH — political association disqualifying for government procurement
political_risk_assessment.achiri: LOW-MEDIUM — consumer-facing, USD1 less visible but USDC preferred
political_risk_assessment.resolution: Use architecture patterns only. USDC on Base. No USD1. No direct SDK dependency.

next_steps: OMEL Sprint 004: Implement Credential Vault using vault-daemon Unix socket pattern
OMEL Sprint 005: Implement Human Brake using policy engine 3-outcome model
Clone repo for source code audit when OMEL sprints begin (not before — avoid premature dependency)
